description: This file defines the SearchFragment class for the search UI in an Android notes application, handling search input, navigation, and UI updates.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A fragment handling search UI, user input, and navigation within the notes app.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up search input handling, and manages focus based on arguments.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click events on notes, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click events on notes, showing a menu.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Updates UI indicators and list based on the current notes.
